loop.top3_why_not: Candidate B, while slightly better on the second window, still underperforms overall and introduces higher variance in the third window. Candidate C uses a meta‑model trained on other series, which can be noisy when only three validation windows are available; its higher validation score does not compensate for the risk of overfitting. Both alternatives are therefore less reliable than the plain mean for this trend‑dominated series.
